notes: Tally export. Every transaction is a voucher (vch_hdr) with double-entry lines (vch_lines). A bank's ledger account is debited when money comes in. TDS deducted by customers is booked to ledger TDS-REC. Unidentified money is parked in ledger SUSP. Card/UPI receipts go to ledger PG-CLR until the gateway pays out. Company rules are in the table mapped as 'policy'. Foreign-currency vouchers have cur <> 'INR' and fx_rate.

customer.notes: names may be in different case

customer_payment.notes: amt is the gross amount settled; the bank received amt minus TDS (see vch_lines: debit on the bank ledger, debit on TDS-REC, credit on the party). party_cd NULL = not a known party.

payment_allocation.notes: Tally bill-wise: 'New Ref' rows are the bills themselves (on Sales vouchers); 'Agst Ref' = a payment applied to bill_ref; 'On Account' = money received but not applied to any bill (bill_ref is NULL).

bank_statement_line.notes: narr is the bank's terse UPPER-CASE text; value_dt can be NULL

vendor_payment.notes: the bank side is the credit line on the bank ledger in vch_lines; cheques show the cheque number in narration
